testcase.name: Scenario: Switch tabs after selecting the expansion pin: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-expansion-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-expansion/ribbon-panel-expansion.feature:154:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Switch tabs after selecting the expansion pin ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active ✔ And the 3D Model Modify additional command area is open ✔ When the user clicks its pin control ✔ And the user selects the Tools ribbon tab ✔ Then the Modify additional command area is no longer visible ✔ When the user selects the 3D Model ribbon tab ✔ Then the Modify additional command area is not automatically displayed ✔ When the user opens the Modify additional command area ✔ And the user clicks an empty area of the viewport ✔ Then the additional command area closes
